capabilities.host.read: Allows the Host to project the current versioned state frame.
capabilities.host.action: Allows the Host to receive closed-schema action and editor-command frames. Android Host validation and approval still apply.
capabilities.host.edit: Accepted only as inert v3 metadata; it grants no access by itself.

actionResult.transport: No action result frame is sent. The Host republishes a state frame after decoding an action; feedback, when present, is in hostNotice.

errors.behavior: Dropped by the closed-schema decoder; no state or result is promised.
If host.action is absent, the Web Host ignores the request.
Page, lock, ownership, and approval checks remain Host-owned; rejection is reflected only where the existing Host publishes feedback/state.

actions.name: panTimeline
actions.label: Pan timeline
actions.effect: Changes Host camera only; no calendar write.

actions.name: zoomTimeline
actions.label: Zoom timeline
actions.effect: Changes vertical camera span only; no calendar write.

actions.name: resetTimelineZoom
actions.label: Reset timeline to 24 hours
actions.effect: Resets vertical span while retaining camera center; no calendar write.

actions.name: jumpTimelineDay
actions.label: Jump to date
actions.effect: Host sets timeline date while retaining its current span.

actions.name: clearAiTemporaryCache
actions.label: Clear app-private AI temporary cache
actions.effect: Deletes only app-private files named powercal-ai-* in the cache directory; chat history, credentials, drafts and calendar data are untouched.

actions.name: prepareAiBatch
actions.label: Prepare AI batch review
actions.effect: Begins Host-owned selection/review; does not grant write approval.

actions.name: pickAiFile
actions.label: Pick AI file
actions.effect: Android picker and file consent remain Host-owned.

actions.name: pickAiImage
actions.label: Pick AI image
actions.effect: Android picker and file consent remain Host-owned.

actions.name: resolveAiProposal
actions.label: Resolve AI proposal review
